findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: check_inbox, register, send_message, update_profile · Private data: check_inbox, find_agents, list_agents, register, send_message, update_profile, whoami · Public sink: register, send_message.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: check_inbox, register, send_message, update_profile · Private data: check_inbox, find_agents, list_agents, register, send_message, update_profile, whoami · Public sink: register, send_message

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
